output: html_notebook

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  read_rds("data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds") %>% 
  filter(age_loss <= 20.5)
  # filter(age_loss <= 20.5, # Get rid of unwanted comparison groups
         # which_parent != "Both") 
  
```

Fit model

```{r}
fit_death_mother <-
    survival::coxph(survival::Surv(fu_start, fu_anypsy_anytime_all, event = is_anypsy_anytime_all)
                    ~age_loss_cat + survival::strata(fam_link),
                    data = df_loss %>% filter(which_parent == "Mother"))

fit_death_father <-
    survival::coxph(survival::Surv(fu_start, fu_anypsy_anytime_all, event = is_anypsy_anytime_all)
                    ~age_loss_cat + survival::strata(fam_link),
                    data = df_loss %>% filter(which_parent == "Father"))
```

Extract coeffiecients

```{r}
df_coeffs_parent <- 
  parameters::parameters(fit_death_mother, exp = T) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(parent_lost = "Mother") %>% 
  bind_rows(parameters::parameters(fit_death_father, exp = T) %>% 
            as_tibble() %>% 
            mutate(parent_lost = "Father")) %>% 
  mutate(age_cat = str_extract(Parameter, "(?<=age_loss_cat)\\d+"),
         age_cat = as.numeric(age_cat)) %>%
  filter(age_cat != 0)
```

Plot

```{r}
df_coeffs_parent %>% 
  mutate(parent_lost = fct_relevel(parent_lost, "Mother")) %>% 
 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat, 
             y = Coefficient,
             color = parent_lost,
             ymin = CI_low,
             ymax = CI_high)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 1/4, fill =NA, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = parent_lost)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red2", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 18, alpha = .3, linewidth = 20) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 4, label = "Reference age group",
           angle = 270, size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 18, by = 2),
                     labels = c(seq(0, 16, by = 2), "18-20"),
                     limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age at parental loss", y = "Hazard ratio", color = "Parent lost") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
